items.text: Career guidance theories are simple maps of how people choose work: matching traits to jobs, developing through life stages, learning from experience and using chance events, and each map is useful for a different kind of decision when you test it against real evidence.
Use the matching idea to shortlist, the stages idea to plan timing, the learning idea to test through experience and the chance idea to stay open to opportunities.
Check any claim about careers with live notices and working people.
